Vimbre keeps each person's tasks, decisions and contacts as they work, so when someone leaves or is away, whoever steps in knows what happened and what to do first. It is a shared decision log and role record for teams.

Vimbre is for teams where people cover for each other. Employees keep their day and finished work in one place. Plans start at £29 a month for up to 10 people. Visit https://vimbre.com/ or contact hello@vimbre.com for general enquiries and support@vimbre.com for account help.
